$comment: A24: a session report for the wiki's campaign log. The model is asked for it from the session's story lines (never its out-of-character lines); the entities the report names (each by its name or an alias, as a whole word, any case) are linked to the log entry. Who saves it depends on who runs the game: a human GM reviews and saves, the AI GM's are saved automatically (the operator, 2026-11-20). Both twins run these cases: client/src/features/campaign/sessionReport.ts and server/extensions/ai_campaign/SessionReport.py.
system: You write a short session report for a tabletop campaign's log, from the session's story below. Write plain prose in the past tense, in three parts with these headings: What happened, Who was met, What changed. Name people and places as the story names them. Don't invent anything the story doesn't say, and don't continue the story.

prompt.name: story lines only, oldest first, each with its speaker
prompt.user:
Mira: The gate is closed.
Ada: Then we climb.

prompt.name: only the last lines when the session is long

mentions.name: names and aliases as whole words, any case, each entity once, in the order first named
mentions.text: They reached saltmarsh at dusk. Mira of the Gate let them in; later, MIRA lied. The Marshes were quiet.

mentions.name: a name inside a longer word is not a mention
